proposals.evidence: DEDR 4096 gives Tamil/Malayalam/Kannada pāl, Telugu pālu, Parji pēl, Tulu pēru and Gondi pāl ‘milk’. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
